notes: Landscape, straight-on, a bookshop's 'New Adult' bay in even shop light, no glare, 2048 px on the long edge so the thinnest spines are at the limit of legibility. Mixed German and English: German-language editions of Colleen Hoover, Ana Huang, Lucy Score, Mona Kasten and others on the six main shelves, English paperbacks in the narrow bay on the right (Hoover, Ana Huang, Dolly Alderton, Taylor Jenkins Reid). Many titles appear several times as spine and cover; each is labelled once. Series with numbered German titles (Save Me/You/Us, Begin/Trust/Feel/Hope/Dream Again, Dunbridge Academy: Anywhere/Anyone, Westwell: Bright & Dark / Hot & Cold, the Twisted books) are labelled by volume. Partial: spines whose title is only part-readable or whose words are broken across the spine (Where Winter Falls, Shine, Unser Lied für immer, Lalaland, Secrets of the Campbell Sisters, Drowning Souls, Tough Choices, The Time I Stayed with You, Jetzt sind wir eins, One Stolen Night, When the Storm Comes, Cherish Whispers, Worlds Apart, Sand Castle Ruins, Ever After, Vielleicht, Proof of Love), It Ends with Us (cover cut by the shelf upright at the far right), The Way You See Me and I'll Always Be with You and Things I Wanted to Say (thin spines at the right, partly hidden). Left out: the purple 'Hearts' spines at the far left of the top shelf, the Mila Blake and Anne Lück spines (author readable, title not), the Kristina Moninger and Stefanie Sante spines on shelves two and four, the dark thin spines between Layla and Verity, the row of narrow purple, green and orange spines on the bottom shelf (Mareen Knoth, Bad Kings and others) that the frame cuts off, the book behind the bottom-left crate, and the far-left bay beyond the 'Need advice?' sign where only Emily Henry's Book Lovers and Royal Blood can be read (both included).
